_about: MAIN RUN. The composition ladder, flat: pairs, triples and the five-way set, each side also asked alone. 12,840 trials.
qwen3-0.6b on v100-vllm085, thinking on (study-think). Every main run of every model shares the design, sizes, repeats and tool_turns of its kind; only the model, the mode and the seed differ.
confirmatory is false: the owner decided on 2026-09-29 that there is no pre-registration, so every result of the main run is exploratory, and insights drawn from it are tested on further models.

Run it with scripts/run_trials.sh main-ladder-qwen3-0.6b-think, or every main run of this model with scripts/run_main.sh qwen3-0.6b. The same command resumes. Records go on the operator's branch, never on master.
